title: Scaffolding and CI gate
objective: Stand up the quality gate before any ported line lands: `mix format --check-formatted`, compile and `mix test --warnings-as-errors` with the flag covering TEST compilation, wired locally and in GitHub Actions. Green on the empty skeleton proves the gate itself.
body:
## Deliverables

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (format + compile + test, warnings-as-errors)
- Green local gate run on the empty skeleton

## Dependencies

- None. Precedes WP-03 (the gate exists before ported code lands).
